title: Concept: iframe srcdoc carrying markup
description: An iframe that builds its document from a srcdoc attribute in a response gives every reader the same visibility the bank has internally: srcdoc renders its value as a full HTML document inside the frame; when the value carries user content the markup runs with the embedding origin's cookies and storage unless the frame is sandboxed.
applicability: The frame inherits the page's origin, so injected markup reaches the session's data.
risk: An iframe is a boundary only if it is sandboxed to a different origin.
